evals.prompt: Review my branch before I create a PR. I'm in /tmp/branch-review-tests/test-repo-1 on the feature/add-search-endpoint branch.
evals.expected_output: File-by-file review that catches: SQL injection in search endpoint, hardcoded API key, storing plaintext passwords, no input validation on create, no confirmation on delete, debug mode enabled, missing tests for new endpoints. Should be constructive with suggestions.
expectations: The review identifies the SQL injection vulnerability in the search endpoint
The review flags the hardcoded API key (sk-prod-abc123secret456)
The review mentions that passwords are stored in plaintext without hashing
The review notes missing input validation on the create_user endpoint
The review notes that debug=True is set in the production code
The review mentions that no tests were added for the new endpoints
The review is organized file-by-file
Each finding includes a concrete suggestion or fix
The review uses severity levels (critical, suggestion, nit, or similar)

evals.prompt: Review my changes before I open a PR. I'm working in /tmp/branch-review-tests/test-repo-3 on feature/task-crud. The base branch is dev.

The review identifies that DeleteTask accesses the map without holding the mutex lock
The review notes that json.Decoder errors are not checked
The review mentions missing input validation (empty title, invalid status values)
The review notes that no tests were added
The review is organized file-by-file
